subject.title: [Feature]: Audio file support in read tool (multimodal parity with images)

question: Should OpenClaw add native audio as a first-class read-tool/model content type, or keep `read()` text/image-only and route audio through transcription/media-understanding until a broader media contract is approved?
rationale: The request crosses product behavior, raw local-media egress, provider serialization, auth/capability routing, and session transcript semantics, so automation should not choose the permanent contract.

options.title: Design native audio contract first
options.body: Approve a typed audio content path only after provider capability checks, payload policy, transcript/audit behavior, and fallback semantics are specified.

options.title: Keep read text/image-only
options.body: Continue using `tools.media.audio` and `openclaw infer audio transcribe` for audio until native model audio has a broader accepted design.

options.title: Consolidate under broader native-media tracker
options.body: Use the overlapping native-audio issue as the product tracker and keep this issue as the read-tool-specific dependent surface.

recommendation.title: Design native audio contract first
recommendation.body: Approve a typed audio content path only after provider capability checks, payload policy, transcript/audit behavior, and fallback semantics are specified.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans core/provider/security/session boundaries where recent history and ownership signals are strongest for this account.
